$comment: The suite-wide allow-list of legacy browser noise for wireStrictPage().
Every entry is a class of regression the whole suite can no longer detect, so
each one must name where it is tracked and why it is here. This file is a
BURN-DOWN: when the tracked defect is fixed, delete the entry rather than
leaving it to mask the next occurrence. Do not add an entry to make a check
pass -- a new console error is the finding (see the 'report, don't encode'
match:   a LITERAL SUBSTRING of the console message or the uncaught error's
stack -- not a regular expression. Use the failing symbol's own name,
which is what makes an entry narrow enough to name one defect. The
loader rejects anything shorter than 8 characters or containing regex
metacharacters, so a pattern cannot be added by mistake and silently
issue:   where removing it is tracked. Either a GitHub issue (#1234) or a
scripts/app-findings-log.test.js fails the build if this names a
finding that is not recorded there, so a baseline entry can never cite
note:    what the defect is, so a reviewer can tell it apart from a new one.

allow.note: The Rx preview pane's expandPreview writes into the preview iframe before it has parsed, raising 'Cannot set properties of null'. Tolerated today by rx-fax-reprint-represcribe; delete this entry when #3578 closes.
